info.name: NextDesk
info.summary: Device sign-in and policy for NextDesk OS
info.description:
Server side of NextDesk OS, a ChromeOS-style desktop for Nextcloud:
- Devices sign in with a Nextcloud app password (Login Flow v2) and log their browser in with a one-time token, so users sign in once. - NextDesk policy (e.g. how long a device may be used offline) with a global value, group overrides (strictest group wins) and user overrides. Managed under Administration settings → Security, with `occ nextdesk:policy` or the OCS API.
info.author: nexed.tech
